# All Nepal National Independent Students' Union (Revolutionary)

ANNISU(R) mural in Bhaktapur, announcing its 17th National ConferenceThe All Nepal National Independent Students Union (Revolutionary) is the student wing of the Communist Party of Nepal-Maoist, a political party in Nepal. It is also referred as ANNISU(R).
The current president of the ANNISU (R) is Vijay Prakash Sharma Sapkota.
